Risk_Description: Combined Damage and Attack Speed reduction may suppress enemy DPS too strongly
Test_Hypothesis: Test combined DPS reduction and target survivability
Interpretation: Combined Cursed Spear and Curse can substantially reduce sustained enemy DPS when both debuffs are active
Next_Action: Playtest combined debuffs against multiple attacker archetypes and compare TTK

Risk_Description: Multiple Boneclub Trolls may create excessive consecutive stun duration
Test_Hypothesis: Test 1–3 Trolls against a single target
Calculated_Result: Requires tests with 1, 2 and 3 Boneclub Trolls
Interpretation: Current single-target calculations do not determine whether multiple Trolls can create excessive consecutive CC

Risk_Description: Guardian Roar combined with Arcane Shield may make the Bear too difficult to eliminate
Test_Hypothesis: Test Bear survivability with and without Arcane Shield
Calculated_Result: Arcane Shield adds 350 HP to Bear; theoretical effective HP increases from 1600 to 1950 (+21.875%); normalized TTK increases from 16 to 19.5 sec
Interpretation: Arcane Shield can meaningfully increase Bear survivability, but the full theoretical benefit requires the 350 HP shield to be consumed during its 6-sec duration
Next_Action: Playtest Guardian Roar + Arcane Shield against burst and sustained damage; measure shield utilization and actual survivability increase

Risk_Description: Reassembled Skeleton may trigger Death Feast again after its second death
Test_Hypothesis: Compare Bone Dragon healing with and without Reassemble deaths
Calculated_Result: Reassemble restores 280 HP; one Death Feast trigger heals 43.2 HP; Death Feast cap = 86.4 HP/sec
Interpretation: Reassembled Skeleton deaths can increase Bone Dragon sustain, but total impact depends on death frequency and positioning
Next_Action: Simulate repeated nearby deaths and compare total Bone Dragon healing

Risk_Description: Cursed Spear may require too much or too little time to activate depending on Spear Devil attack rate
Test_Hypothesis: Measure time to reach 3 hits and compare it with typical combat and burst windows
Calculated_Result: Attack Interval = 1.2 sec; 3 hits require 2 intervals after the first hit; Time_to_Proc = (3-1)*1.2 = 2.4 sec
Interpretation: Cursed Spear requires 2.4 sec from the first successful hit to the third hit that activates the debuff
Next_Action: Validate 2.4-sec Time_to_Proc against burst windows and realistic target movement

Risk_Description: Curse and Blood Rush modify Attack Speed in opposite directions and require a consistent stacking rule
Test_Hypothesis: Compare additive and multiplicative modifier models and measure their effect on Goblin DPS
Interpretation: Under the current multiplicative model Curse partially offsets Blood Rush without completely cancelling it
Next_Action: Compare multiplicative model with alternative stacking rule and choose one global modifier rule
